description: Medium-project candidates bound to the active Lifecycle V1 portfolio.

selection_policy.include: Mature, active, public repositories smaller than Django/Terraform but with realistic issue-derived software-engineering task surfaces and bounded verifiers.
selection_policy.exclude: Toy fixtures, archived repositories, user-owned projects, and projects without repeatable targeted tests.
selection_policy.promotion_required: Pin real fixed commits, freeze setup/reset/verifier commands, and preserve planned baseline/treatment records before execution.
selection_policy.benchmark_inspiration: Authentic upstream-derived feature, behavior-preserving refactor, and reviewed-change correction tasks with lenient controller-only acceptance.
selection_policy.target_matrix: Two active medium workflows: Fastify (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Beets (Python).

candidates.setup_policy: Clone a pinned commit, install Node dependencies with the repo-pinned package manager, apply seeded production regressions, and freeze targeted test commands. Current candidate scaffold provides setup/reset/smoke scripts at the fixture root.
candidates.verifier_policy: Use bounded npm/pnpm test selectors for affected Fastify subsystems and record any package-manager or Node-version constraints explicitly.

candidates.setup_policy: Use the pinned 9acb1ecf snapshot, apply the qualified composite seed once, conceal controller assets, disclose the three lifecycle prompts sequentially, and preserve warm repository/model state until final cumulative verification.
candidates.verifier_policy: Use targeted pytest selectors for affected CLI/library/plugin behavior; avoid full-suite runs unless needed for diagnosis.
